These are *single task observations* with different bounded prompts/repair behavior, not a generalized model benchmark or proof 7B dominates smaller models across all tasks. Model weights were never fine-tuned.

## Strict unverified properties

Passing ten authored tests does **not** establish all possible semantic requirements. In particular, the generated code uses an inherited-property check (`'qty' in item`) rather than an own-property check, and does not fully reject non-plain objects. The published ten-case suite did not measure those inputs. **This is an identified defect/risk**, not a certified complete invoice library. Add independent prototype/own-property edge cases and repeat model generation + QA before promoting this module into any product.

No authenticated customer, deployment, real agent worker, HANTER runtime integration, production VELION model endpoint, AI Passport, Guardian Core approval, signed Approval Gateway authorization, anchored Audit Ledger, professional LEGION/NCA qualification, independent human security review or economic revenue is claimed.

**Release is DENIED**; no production/paid/crypto operation was performed. No generated module may be sold or deployed based solely on this checkpoint. Source hashes are not release signatures. The ephemeral GitHub runner is not a 24/7 service and restricted Docker execution is not mathematically guaranteed sandbox isolation.
